verified_facts: The National Building Control Office's BCMS documentation distinguishes a Commencement Notice from a Certificate of Compliance on Completion.

A Certificate of Compliance on Completion links back to the relevant Commencement/7 Day Notice reference and contains certification by the builder concerning compliance with the Building Regulations insofar as they apply.
The national building-control open-data portal contains Commencement Notice and Certificate of Compliance on Completion data submitted through BCMS for all 31 Building Control Authorities since 2014.
guardrails: A commencement notice proves notification/registration of proposed works, not completed compliance.
A completion certificate is evidence within the building-control certification framework; it is not planning permission or proof of title.
Do not infer document authenticity solely from a user-uploaded copy; where possible reconcile the reference with the relevant official record.
Historical works require the regulatory framework applicable when the work occurred.
Conflicting dates, property identifiers or document references trigger CONFLICT rather than automatic acceptance.
